speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The first mitigation measure has now been incorporated into the project plan.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Environmental groups have welcomed the government's response, but several organizations argue that additional action may still be necessary.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: The wind park remains a cornerstone of Arcadia's climate strategy and contributes significantly to SDGs 7 and 13.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: However, every additional environmental measure affects project costs or energy production.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The question is no longer whether we should protect migratory birds.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The question is how far we are willing to go while maintaining the project's economic and energy objectives.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Some options may better protect the wetland and strengthen compliance with international obligations, but they may also affect tourism, fisheries, or renewable energy generation.
